subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “They stopped, watched, and shared.”?
options: It became a place where people learned how to keep living things alive after taking them home.
The question is not only whether something is smart, but whether the people using it are prepared.
But it showed that change becomes easier when people can see it, count it, and do it together.
A public space becomes more alive when ordinary people are invited to add something of their own.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It became a place where people learned how to keep living things alive after taking them home.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The question is not only whether something is smart, but whether the people using it are prepared.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「But it showed that change becomes easier when people can see it, count it, and do it together.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「They stopped, watched, and shared. A public space becomes more alive when ordinary people are invited to add something of their own.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They stopped, watched, and shared. A public space becomes more alive when ordinary people are invited to add something of their own.」，答案為「A public space becomes more alive when ordinary people are invited to add something of their own.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A public space becomes more alive when ordinary people are invited to add something of their own.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
